note: Rates are per million tokens, in USD, at published list prices, each read off the vendor's own pricing page on the date above. Claude Sonnet 5 is $2/$10: the introductory rate announced through 2026-08-31 is now the standard price and the scheduled increase to $3/$15 was cancelled, so an earlier version of this table overstated Anthropic by 50%. OpenAI's gpt-5.4 is the STANDARD tier under 272K context; the Batch and Flex tiers are half that and Fast Mode is double, and this tool makes ordinary synchronous calls. Bedrock is partner-priced by AWS and is NOT interchangeable with Anthropic first-party rates; the figures here are US East, and other regions differ (Asia Pacific Sydney is $0.5459/$2.7398). Cached input is cheaper than fresh input at every vendor and this table does not model it, so a run that hits a cache costs less than reported, never more. A local runtime has no per-token price at all — its cost is hardware and electricity, which this tool does not attempt to model, and it is reported as not priced rather than as free. Override with --prices to use your negotiated rates.
